character: Ski area around the Gotthard and Oberalp passes, linking Andermatt in Uri with Sedrun and Disentis in Graubünden over the Oberalp. The separate Gemsstock (2,961 m) above Andermatt is known for steep black runs, off-piste bowls and freeride lines.
